description: Header file declaring utility functions for number formatting within the UnitConversionManager namespace, including trimming zeros, digit counting, rounding, and scientific notation conversion.
external_methods: std::wstring RoundSignificantDigits(double value, unsigned int numberSignificantDigits)

methods.name: TrimTrailingZeros
methods.description: Removes trailing zeros from a wide string number representation.

methods.name: GetNumberDigits
methods.description: Returns the total number of digits in a wide string number.

methods.name: GetNumberDigitsWholeNumberPart
methods.description: Returns the number of digits in the whole number part of a double value.

methods.name: RoundSignificantDigits
methods.description: Rounds a double value to a specified number of significant digits and returns it as a wide string.

methods.name: ToScientificNumber
methods.description: Converts a double value to its scientific notation as a wide string.
